theme: harbor pilot assigning berths as ships come and go
title: Harbor Pilot and the Warm Berth
strategies: trivial: whenever several free berths of the right size exist, actively AVOID the one on a sector the crew's roster currently remembers, and ALWAYS rejoin a freed berth with its sibling right away -- deliberately locality-blind, matches the checker's own weak reference

greedy: textbook lowest-address/best-fit placement plus ALWAYS eager-coalescing on free -- correct and tidy, but blind to which sectors the crew's roster remembers, and reflexively destroys a berth about to be reused

strong: place new ships on a free berth whose SECTOR is currently warm in the crew's LRU roster (falling back to lowest-address only when nothing is warm); defer coalescing a freed berth whenever the exact same size will be requested again later in the trace, coalescing only once it provably will not -- both decisions exploit full visibility of the trace

headroom above strong: model TLB eviction pressure from the whole future trace jointly (not just 'needed again: yes/no') to also choose WHICH warm candidate to sacrifice for a large split, and hedge coalescing against interleaved ships of other sizes
